recommendations.proposed_use: Supervisor loop memory and RAG for sprint context persistence across sessions
risks: External network calls to Ruflo memory service
Memory store may contain stale context that confuses sprint planner
Authority confusion if Ruflo outputs treated as evidence
mitigation: Only consume Ruflo signals if Supervisor approved mode >= audit_only
All Ruflo signals must be tagged runtime_advisory not authoritative
Ruflo never replaces poc-targets.yaml or evidence files
evidence_needed_before_activation: Ruflo mode documented in sprint prompt
Test: Ruflo signal does not change poc-targets.yaml checksum

recommendations.proposed_use: Skills stream intake of community AI agent skills for test generation and code pattern analysis
risks: Community plugins may have unsafe execution contracts
Registry pollution if skills bypass normalization
mitigation: All skills must pass Skills normalization before registry entry
Each skill must have allowed_files and forbidden_files defined
evidence_needed_before_activation: Skills stream normalization completed for selected skill
skill-registry.yaml entry added by Skills stream

recommendations.proposed_use: Binary format analysis for undocumented or complex binary format specifications (e.g., future proprietary format work)
risks: Binary analysis of proprietary files may violate license
Decompiled code must not be copied into product source
Analysis output used as authority without test evidence
mitigation: Only analyze owned, open, test-fixture, or explicitly authorized binaries
All output stays at authority_state: ai_draft
Supervisor must approve via policies.yaml before any use
evidence_needed_before_activation: GhidraMCP analysis summary reviewed by human
